in_marathi.name: Kayan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kaya' which means body or form. Kayan is a powerful and bold name for a boy in Hindu tradition.
